description.value: Homestead Cider is a family-run farm cidery nestled between Mount Cheam and Bear Mountain in Agassiz, crafting cider from estate-grown apples and local BC ingredients. The cidery features a beautiful outdoor picnic area with mountain views, rotating food trucks throughout the summer, and live music on select evenings. It is dog and kid friendly, and products can also be purchased for pickup or local delivery through the online store.
